text:
"I have no other," I have told him

and repeated many times.

And I heard him saying inside me

not in words, confusedly,

but precise, he was saying inside me

or from the bottom of the universe:

"And I have no other but you"

translation.title: "I Have No Other," I Have Told Him
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the prayerlike exchange as an inner voice or a voice from the universe.
